summary: On August 17, 2026, XTI Aerospace CEO and Chairman Scott Pomeroy resigned immediately, accepted by the board, signing a Separation and Release of Claims Agreement providing a $200,000 payment and immediate vesting of options for 2,000,000 shares. The board established an independent committee for an internal review of Pomeroy and governance matters, with no timeline set. Director Jonathan Ornstein was elected Interim Chairman. The filing does not indicate any impact on previously issued financials. Watch for the review's outcome and potential governance or disclosure adjustments.
